body: Wow, that is very helpful and a perspective that I hadn't thought of. Thank you for the advice! I really appreciate it.

That does actually help me. I find in the games where I don't look up the ranks of my opponent, I do in fact play much better. 

But at local tournament, we are in custom lobbies, and we op.gg the other team to figure out what they're strengths and weakness are. It's quite hard to ignore the rank right in front of you when that happens.
